details.summary: The gateway upstream timeout was temporarily tightened to 80ms, causing clients to quickly time out and retry. This saturated backend services (orders and inventory), leading to database connection pool exhaustion and eventually causing the orders pod to be OOMKilled due to its tight memory limits. After reverting the gateway configuration, the orders pod remains stuck in a CrashLoopBackOff loop under the immediate load.
